description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.4.4
🐛 Fixes
- Alias Creation for Mono Versions fixed, Mono versions now create as .cmd files instead of their exe versions due to some issues with Mono versions
✨ Improvements
- Add Redirect Link to Github/Gitlab Auth Modal for AppImage users, since the button doesnt work
- File namings on Github Release Page for GodotHub have been changed to be more user friendly and easy to understand
- Add Missing Japanese Locale Keys; PR by shiena
